title: Grateful Dead Live at St. Paul Civic Center on 1982-08-06
lineage: Cassette (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/96k) ->Samplitude Professional v11.2 -> FLAC/16
source: SBD -> Cassette Master -> Cassette (Sony TC-D5M/Dolby B/TDK MA-C90)

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard recording of a high‑energy Brent‑era show, highlighted by a smoking Bird Song and standout jams on Lazy Lightning / Supplication and Lost Sailor / Saint.
ai_review.review: The SBD capture is clear with only brief AUD glitches and a pleasant vocal echo that adds ambience. The performance shines throughout the first set—often called the finest Brent‑era opening—and erupts in high‑octane jams on Bird Song, Lazy Lightning > Supplication, Scarlet > Fire and Lost Sailor > Saint, making it a must‑hear concert.

ai_rating.rationale: Overwhelmingly positive reviews praise both the musical performance and recording quality; only one moderate comment and a tongue‑in‑cheek low rating slightly temper the score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and well‑balanced SBD with brief AUD patches that are not intrusive; a subtle echo on vocals adds ambience, and bass response is solid for the May‑onward era.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set is praised as one of the finest Brent‑era openings, leading into an explosive second set with seamless transitions and high‑energy jams.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Excellent playing highlighted throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent-era keyboards noted positively; overall sound is full and balanced.
